document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your heedless flight through the dark woods has shaken off 
your pursuers. Now only Sylvia and Norman remain with you. 
You look at their exhausted faces and vow to find a way out of 
this accursed valley.
